description: This source file defines the AzureQueueAdapterReceiver class, which implements an interface for receiving and processing message batches from an Azure Storage Queue within the Orleans streaming infrastructure. The class handles message retrieval, acknowledgment, and deletion operations, and manages pending messages.

classes.name: AzureQueueAdapterReceiver
classes.description: Implements an interface for receiving message batches from an Azure Storage Queue, including message retrieval, processing, and acknowledgment functionalities.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of AzureQueueAdapterReceiver with provided configuration and dependencies.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the queue, preparing it for message operations.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the receiver, awaiting pending operations.

methods.name: GetQueueMessagesAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a batch of messages from the Azure Storage Queue.

methods.name: MessagesDeliveredAsync
methods.description: Processes acknowledgments for delivered messages and deletes them from the queue.
